Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 9 · NFL Week 9 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 8, 12:08 PM ET

Josh Allen has the highest SPAGS projection in the Bills at Vikings DraftKings Showdown: 19.9 points at $11,400 FLEX, 29.9 at captain for $17,100. In a game totaled at 43.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.7 times, and across 10,000 simulations he holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Allen is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 6.4 points at an $11,400 FLEX salary.

He also has the largest captain share: 21.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Allen at captain. James Cook III is the next captain in line, at 20.6%. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.4 targets.

Buffalo is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.25 for the Bills and 20.25 for the Vikings.

Behind Allen and Cook, the next projections are Justin Jefferson (15.9, $9,800), Carson Wentz (15.2, $9,000) and T.J. Hockenson (10.7, $5,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 8, 12:08 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Josh Allen, BUF QB ($11,400 FLEX / $17,100 CPT)

Josh Allen holds 21.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,100 and the 19.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.7 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 19.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 39.9. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 21.4% as the captain and 51.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: James Cook III, BUF RB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

James Cook III holds 20.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 17.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 2.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Cook averaged 17.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.8 and a ceiling of 35.5. He holds 61% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 20.6% as the captain and 40.7% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Justin Jefferson, MIN WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Justin Jefferson holds 17.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 15.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.2 targets on 25.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 16.0 points with a simulated floor of 3.3 and a ceiling of 42.7. He holds 48% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.9% as the captain and 30.2% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Bills vs Vikings

Carson Wentz, MIN QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Carson Wentz carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.2 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Wentz averaged 15.2 points with a simulated floor of 5.4 and a ceiling of 30.6. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.7% as the captain and 48.4% in a FLEX spot.

T.J. Hockenson, MIN TE ($5,400 FLEX / $8,100 CPT)

T.J. Hockenson carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.7 DraftKings points for a $5,400 FLEX salary ($8,100 at captain). The model gives him 4.7 targets on 17.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Hockenson averaged 10.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.5 and a ceiling of 26.8. He holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.7% as the captain and 32.2% in a FLEX spot.

Dalton Kincaid, BUF TE ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Dalton Kincaid carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.4 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 4.8 targets on 18.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Kincaid averaged 10.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.0 and a ceiling of 25.6. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.1% as the captain and 25.8% in a FLEX spot.

DJ Moore, BUF WR ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

DJ Moore carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.3 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 3.9 targets on 15.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Moore averaged 10.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.2 and a ceiling of 22.2. He holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.0% as the captain and 27.2% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Tyler Bass, BUF K ($4,600 FLEX / $6,900 CPT)

Tyler Bass projects for 8.3 DraftKings points at a $4,600 FLEX salary, 1.81 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Bass averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 16.0. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.9% as the captain and 26.2% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Bills, BUF DST ($4,000 FLEX / $6,000 CPT)

Bills projects for 6.4 DraftKings points at a $4,000 FLEX salary, 1.60 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Bills averaged 6.6 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.4. It holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.6% as the captain and 22.3% in a FLEX spot.

Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown?

Josh Allen holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 21.4%, ahead of James Cook III (20.6%) and Justin Jefferson (17.9%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Bills vs Vikings?

Build around Justin Jefferson at captain with James Cook III, Carson Wentz and Jordan Addison at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (13 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,100 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown?

Josh Allen leads the SPAGS model at 19.9 DraftKings points for $11,400 at FLEX, or 29.9 points at captain for $17,100.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Bills vs Vikings Showdown?

Josh Allen is the most expensive player at $11,400 FLEX and $17,100 at captain. All 31 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Bills vs Vikings DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Tyler Bass (8.3 points at $4,600), Bills (6.4 points at $4,000) and Vikings (5.6 points at $3,600).

What is the Bills vs Vikings spread and total?

The Bills are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 43.5, with implied team totals of 23.25 for the Bills and 20.25 for the Vikings.
